Nora (eng-sre): follow-up from the kv-eviction postmortem  need an actionable testing/playbook list. short please.
Vik (eng-platform): +1. my top 3: pre-merge goldens (2 prompts), nightly prefix-sweep load (30m), and a chaos microdrill (20m).
Eve (eng-ml): i'll curate goldens and a 60-prompt regression pack (categories: long-prefix, burst, mixed). ETA: 7 days for initial pack.
Nora (eng-sre): i'll own chaos drill and runbook. criteria: capture eviction heatmap, define rollback on tail-latency + eviction-rate. ETA: 10 days.
Vik (eng-platform): i'll add CI jobs: pre-merge/kv-goldens (fast) and nightly/prefix-sweep (staging). will push metrics to eval-db. ETA: 9 days.
ops-bot: Created epic EPI-3337 "kv-eviction-tests-and-playbook". Subtasks: EPI-3337-1 goldens+pack (Eve) due 1820590000, EPI-3337-2 ci jobs+dashboards (Vik) due 1820670000, EPI-3337-3 chaos runbook+drill (Nora) due 1820700000.
Nora (eng-sre): add recurring monthly "kv-regression review" to oncall checklist; rotate owner SRE <-> Platform.
Eve (eng-ml): will tag two goldens as @prod-guard for pre-merge.
Vik (eng-platform): sample pre-merge job: pytest tests/regressions/test_goldens.py -k golden (goal <30s).
Nora (eng-sre): summary: owners assigned, epic created, staging canary target = 14 days. reconvene in 6 days for status. :thumbsup:
